The *Latāvimānavatthu* (Vv 32), translated as "Latā’s Mansion," is a verse narrative preserved in the *Vimānavatthu* section of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts how the daughters of the god Sakka explain the deeds that led to their rebirth as devas enjoying divine happiness [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].
No curated cross-canonical parallels are identified on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
